capabilities: Load Font Awesome assets so Mermaid icons render
Register additional icon sets (logos, lucide, clarity) via the Mermaid API
Insert icons through a fuzzy search command
Browse and filter supported icons in settings
extras: Relies on third-party icon sets under their own licenses (CC BY 4.0, SIL OFL 1.1, ISC, MIT, CC0).
intentEvidence: Correctly displays Font Awesome icons in mermaid diagrams, which are defaultly supported by Mermaid but not to be rendered properly in Obsidian.
problem: Obsidian does not load the Font Awesome stylesheet Mermaid expects, so icons in diagrams do not render, and other icon sets are unsupported.

relations.evidence: This plugin utilizes the following open-source icon sets. Thank you to their creators and contributors. - Font Awesome Free
Iconify - SVG Logos (logos): Licensed under CC0 1.0 Universal.

summary: Icon support for Mermaid diagrams that fixes Font Awesome rendering and adds logos, Lucide, and Clarity icon sets.
